Search results consistently place EBS Healthcare headquarters at 200 Skiles Blvd, West Chester, PA 19382

profile.summary: A Pennsylvania-based company that provides school-based, clinic-based and home-based behavioral and therapeutic services to children with autism, special needs, and developmental or behavior issues. It was acquired by The Stepping Stones Group in March 2021 and remains a legally separate entity.

sources.title: The Stepping Stones Group acquires EBS Healthcare
